claim.description: The one specific claim this post makes, in a sentence.

hook.description: The single opening promise. Under 48 characters and 10 words. It must be the caption's first line and the exact first on-screen line for a Reel or slide one headline for a carousel.

detail.description: The specific proof behind the claim: a source finding, named case, observed situation, or usable framework. Never invent a statistic.

source_url.description: Required when type is source. A direct URL for the factual claim.

slides.description: Required when format is carousel. 6-8 items.

headline.description: Max 70 chars (60 on slides 1 and last).

reel_script.description: Required when format is reel. 6-10 beats, total under 90 seconds.

onscreen.description: Max 48 chars. Burned onto the video.

direction.description: What is on camera during this beat.

reel_cover.description: Required for Reels only. The separate profile-grid cover; it must package the tension without repeating the first frame.

headline.description: 2-6 words, max 36 characters. A concrete situation with an unresolved tension. Must connect to the hook's subject and payoff; paraphrasing is welcome.

signal.description: Max 24 characters. A concrete number, trade-off, or proof fragment from the Reel, shown as a visual label.

layout.description: Choose the visual device that best fits the tension. Vary it deliberately across Reels.

caption.description: Full caption WITHOUT hashtags. Structure: hook, payoff, substance, POV line, send-oriented CTA.

hashtags.description: Exactly 5 or fewer. Instagram enforces a hard cap of 5.

cta.description: The send-oriented call to action, repeated separately for reference.

failure_mode.description: The honest reason this post might land badly or read as generic.

title: the cx score trap nps
claim: A single contact’s NPS response cannot reliably represent every stakeholder or predict an account renewal.

evidence.detail: Gartner's research puts the average B2B buying group at six to ten people, while NPS surveys typically reach one friendly contact in the CRM.

visible_steps: Review the last two renewal cycles
Count people contacted in the last 90 days
Read NRR as a lagging outcome

slides.headline: NPS measures one contact, not the buying committee.
slides.body: Gartner puts B2B buying groups at six to ten people. NPS surveys usually reach whoever answers emails fastest.

items.label: Who buys in B2B
items.detail: Six to ten stakeholders across departments

visual.note: Based on Gartner buying group research

slides.headline: A high score can miss a changing buying group.
slides.body: Champions leave, procurement leads change, and silent accounts drop contracts while the quarterly dashboard shows a 58.

slides.headline: Teams keep reporting NPS because building health models is hard.
slides.body: NPS is cheap to collect and easy to chart. Replacing it requires building a multi-stakeholder health score.

visual.note: Observed reporting patterns in industrial firms

slides.headline: Do not kill NPS overnight. Report the gap instead.
slides.body: Keep NPS on the board deck for context. Put net revenue retention directly next to it to show the real story.

items.label: NRR Reality
items.detail: Net revenue retention sits at 91 percent

slides.headline: Replace single-score dashboards with four account signals.
slides.body: Track retention, the last two renewal cycles, stakeholder contact in 90 days and the executive sponsor’s view.

items.label: Commercial trend
items.detail: Review the last two renewal cycles

items.label: Stakeholder breadth
items.detail: Count people contacted in the last 90 days

items.label: Retention
items.detail: Read NRR as a lagging outcome

slides.headline: Read the score alongside account signals.
slides.body: Read the long version and methodology notes on https://www.rachitmishra.in/2026/07/27/nps-limitations-b2b/

caption:
Good NPS won't stop churn.

NPS limitations in B2B begin with the gap between one respondent and a whole buying group.

Keep the score for context. Alongside it, review revenue retention, the last two renewal cycles, stakeholder contact over 90 days and the executive sponsor’s concerns. These signals add context; none is a guaranteed churn forecast. Make the account view broader than the easiest person to survey.

Read the source: https://www.rachitmishra.in/2026/07/27/nps-limitations-b2b/

Send this to the account owner preparing the next renewal review.
